definitions.gloss: epidemic prevention; disease control; quarantine measures
definitions.explanation: Measures and activities aimed at preventing the spread of infectious diseases. Includes quarantine, vaccination campaigns, disinfection, and public health monitoring.

examples.japanese: {防疫|ぼうえき}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}→強化：00260_kyouka⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{防疫|ぼうえき}⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見直|みなお}されている→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。
examples.english: The quarantine system at airports is being reviewed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦インフルエンザ→インフルエンザ：05384_infuruenza⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{防疫|ぼうえき}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{鶏|にわとり}→鶏：05202_niwatori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{殺処分|さつしょぶん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: In the area where bird flu broke out, chickens were culled as part of disease control operations.

notes:
WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with the homophone ⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧ (trade/commerce). Both are read ぼうえき but written with different kanji and have completely unrelated meanings.

USAGE:
A technical term that became much more familiar to the general public during the COVID-19 pandemic. Commonly seen in news about infectious disease outbreaks, animal diseases (bird flu, foot-and-mouth disease), and border control measures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防疫|ぼうえき}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ (disease prevention measures)
- {防疫|ぼうえき}⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧ (disease control system)
- {防疫|ぼうえき}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧ (quarantine/disease control operations)
